passives.name: Skyward Manager
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Greatly reduces damage taken by the Boss. Weakness Gauge can be reduced only when hit if all surviving allies are inflicted with Shocked. If an ally is inflicted with a debuff when hit, reduces Priority of all allies by 50%. (Only once per turn) At the start of the Boss's or Epsilon's turn, removes all debuffs from the caster. When the Boss is inflicted with Break, the reduced damage taken and immunity to Weakness Gauge reduction effects are removed.
